_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Grade 10-12 Geography Syllabus' (2013, published by CDC). Topic/sub-topic names and Specific Outcome statements for Topics 10.1 (Map Work) and 10.2 (The Solar System) only — the source PDF's table has 6 columns (Topic/Sub-topic/Specific Outcomes/Content split into Knowledge, Skills, Values) and text-extracts with columns interleaved out of order for the remaining Grade 10 topics (10.3-10.8), which risks misattributing content between sub-topics if reconstructed automatically; those are intentionally left out until they can be verified more carefully rather than guessed. The 'Content' (Knowledge/Skills/Values) columns are omitted even for 10.1-10.2 for the same reason — only the numbered Specific Outcomes are included, since their sub-topic association is unambiguous from the outcome's own code prefix. One exception: sub-topics 10.2.6 and 10.2.7 both carry the code prefix '10.2.7.x' in the source document itself (an apparent numbering error in the original, not an extraction artifact) — their outcome statements are included without that ambiguous code. The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term, so all of Grade 10 is modeled as a single term here.

curriculum.name: 2013 Outcome-Based Curriculum
curriculum.description: Zambia's 2013 outcome-based curriculum for Grades 10-12 (Senior Secondary).

subject.name: Geography
subject.description: Senior Secondary Geography syllabus, Grade 10-12 (Curriculum Development Centre, 2013).

terms.name: Year (not term-divided in the source syllabus)

topics.name: 10.1 Map Work: Basic Techniques and Skills

competencies.description: Match conventional signs with ground features
Measure real distances between objects in the field
Translate map distances into real distances
Compute the gradient (slope) between two features on the map
Identify relief features and drainage patterns using contour lines on a map
Identify factors which influence human settlements and activities on a map
Identify vegetation and land-use types
Account for observed vegetation and land use patterns
Identify and present variables on a graphical axis
Draw a sketch map from topographic maps
Draw a cross-section between two points on a map

topics.name: 10.2 The Solar System
topics.description: Section B: Elements of Physical Geography.

competencies.description: Describe the solar system
Describe the shape of the Earth
Explain latitude and longitude
Locate places on the Earth's surface using latitudes and longitudes
Calculate distances using latitudes
Calculate local time using longitudes
Calculate longitude from local time
Explain the International Date Line
Calculate time and date east or west of the International Date Line

sub_topics.name: 10.2.6 Apparent Movement of the Sun (Angle of Elevation)

competencies.description: Calculate the position of the midday sun (angle of elevation) at a given latitude at different times of the year
Calculate the latitude of a place using the position of the midday sun (angle of elevation)

sub_topics.name: 10.2.7 Rotation and Revolution of the Earth

competencies.description: Explain the effects of rotation of the earth
Explain the effects of the earth's revolution
